_setup: Azure portal > Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations > New registration.
Use the v2.0 issuer. The v1 endpoints behave differently and are not covered here.
Entra templates the tenant into the published issuer, so the discovery document's
issuer can differ from the configured one. That is why the verifier takes a list.
Then: export ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET=... && node conformance/run.mjs entra
